entries.summaryZh: 切里尼奥拉战役发生于1503年4月28日，是西班牙与法国军队在意大利南部普利亚地区切里尼奥拉城外的一场交战。西班牙将领科尔多瓦率约9000人，以火绳枪兵与炮兵击退法军骑兵与瑞士长枪兵，法军主帅内穆尔公爵阵亡。此役常被认为是欧洲第一场由小型火器决定胜负的会战。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Cerignola was fought on 28 April 1503 between Spanish and French armies outside Cerignola in Apulia. Gonzalo Fernandez de Cordoba's Spanish force of 9,000, with arquebusiers and artillery, broke the attacks of French gendarmes and Swiss pikemen; the French commander, the Duke of Nemours, was killed. It is often called the first European battle decided by firearms.
entries.significanceZh: 此役被认为开启了火器主导欧洲战场的时代，也巩固了西班牙在意大利南部的优势。
entries.significanceEn: It is seen as the beginning of firearms' dominance on European battlefields and confirmed Spanish power in southern Italy.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为1503年4月28日，与英文维基正文一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 28 April 1503, matching the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event; the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 勒卡托战役发生于1914年8月26日，是第一次世界大战西线的一次交战。英国远征军与法国第五集团军在沙勒罗瓦与蒙斯战败后向北撤退，英军第二军随后在勒卡托进行阻滞作战，以延缓德军追击。远征军大部得以继续后撤至圣康坦，避免了被合围。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Le Cateau was fought on the Western Front on 26 August 1914. After their defeats at Charleroi and Mons, the British Expeditionary Force and the French Fifth Army were retreating; the British II Corps fought a delaying action at Le Cateau to slow the German pursuit. Most of the BEF continued its retreat to Saint-Quentin.
entries.significanceZh: 此役的阻滞为远征军赢得时间，使其在1914年大撤退中免于被歼。
entries.significanceEn: The delaying action bought the BEF time and saved it from destruction during the Great Retreat of 1914.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为1914年8月26日，与英文维基正文一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 26 August 1914, matching the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event; the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 西德曼战役发生于1798年10月7日，是拿破仑远征埃及期间的一场战役。埃及马穆鲁克军队在金字塔战役战败后向南撤退，路易·德赛将军率法军追击，双方在西德曼村附近相遇。穆拉德贝伊尝试了若干新战术但未能奏效，被迫继续向南方的上埃及撤退。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Sediman was fought on 7 October 1798 during Napoleon's Egyptian campaign. After the Egyptian defeat at the Pyramids the Mamluk force retreated south, and General Louis Desaix pursued it; the two sides met near Sediman. Murad Bey's attempts at new tactics failed and he was forced to continue his retreat southwards.
entries.significanceZh: 此役后穆拉德贝伊继续南撤，法军得以深入上埃及追击。
entries.significanceEn: After the battle Murad Bey continued his retreat south and the French were able to pursue him deeper into Upper Egypt.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为1798年10月7日，与中文维基正文一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科有该条目（标题「西德曼之战」），英文维基百科尚无该条目，本条目主要据中文维基与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 7 October 1798, matching the Chinese article, and the entry keeps year precision. A Chinese Wikipedia article exists (titled Sediman) while the English Wikipedia has no article for this event; the entry is written from the Chinese article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 泰西封战役发生于363年5月29日，是罗马皇帝尤利安远征萨珊波斯期间在波斯首都泰西封城外进行的一场交战。罗马军队与沙普尔二世治下的萨珊波斯军队对阵，罗马一方在城下获胜，但因远离己方补给线而无法继续推进，这次远征随后以失败告终。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Ctesiphon took place on 29 May 363 between the army of the Roman emperor Julian and the Sasanian forces of Shapur II outside the walls of the Persian capital. The Romans won, but found themselves too far from their supply lines to continue the campaign, which ended in failure.
entries.significanceZh: 罗马虽在城下获胜却无力续攻，此役暴露出远征军深入波斯的补给困境。
entries.significanceEn: The victory outside the capital could not be exploited, exposing how far the Roman expedition had outrun its supply lines.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为363年5月29日，与英文维基正文一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 29 May 363, matching the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event; the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 韦兹龙斯之战发生于524年6月21日，地点在今法国伊泽尔省，是法兰克国王克洛多梅尔与勃艮第国王戈多马尔之间的交战。此役是克洛维一世诸子瓜分勃艮第远征的一部分；据图尔的格列高利记载，克洛多梅尔误入敌阵被杀，戈多马尔虽胜，其王国仍在十年内被墨洛温王朝吞并。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Vezronce was fought on 21 June 524 near Vezronce-Curtin in Isere, France, between the Franks under King Chlodomer and the Burgundians under King Godomar. It was part of Clovis I's sons' campaign against Burgundy; Chlodomer was killed riding into the enemy line, and Godomar's kingdom was absorbed within a decade.
entries.significanceZh: 此役虽由勃艮第方面获胜，但勃艮第王国仍在十年内被墨洛温王朝吞并。
entries.significanceEn: Godomar won the battle, but the Burgundian kingdom was absorbed by the Merovingians within a decade.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 记为524年6月25日，英文维基正文记为524年6月21日，两者年份一致、日期相差四天，本条采用年精度并保留该分歧。中文维基百科尚无该条目。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级未改动。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 25 June 524 while the English article gives 21 June 524; the year agrees and the entry keeps year precision, with the day-level difference recorded here. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 大土陵战役发生于公元1882年9月13日，地点在开罗东北约110公里处的埃及大土陵，是1882年英埃战争中具有决定意义的交战。由加尼特·沃尔斯利中将统率的英国军队趁夜接近，对艾哈迈德·阿拉比指挥的筑垒埃及军队发动突袭并将其击败。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Tel el-Kebir was fought on 13 September 1882 at Tell El Kebir in Egypt, 110 km north-east of Cairo, and proved the decisive engagement of the Anglo-Egyptian War. A British army under Lieutenant General Sir Garnet Wolseley approached under cover of darkness and defeated the entrenched Egyptian force commanded by Ahmed Urabi in a sudden assault.
entries.significanceZh: 此役决定了英埃战争的结局，阿拉比的抵抗随之瓦解。
entries.significanceEn: It decided the outcome of the Anglo-Egyptian War and broke Urabi's resistance.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为1882年9月13日，与英文维基正文一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 13 September 1882, matching the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event; the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 法尔战役（又称贝桑战役）发生于634年12月或635年1月，是穆斯林征服拜占庭叙利亚期间的一场重要交战，地点在约旦河谷的佩拉（法尔）与斯基托波利斯（贝桑）附近。此前在阿杰纳代因溃败的拜占庭军队在此重新集结，阿拉伯军队追击而至，克服了被放水淹没的地面并最终取胜。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Fahl, also called the Battle of Beisan, was a major engagement of the Muslim conquest of Byzantine Syria, fought at or near Pella and Scythopolis in the Jordan Valley in December 634 or January 635. Byzantine troops regrouped there after their rout at Ajnadayn; the Muslims pursued them, overcame flooded ground and won.
entries.significanceZh: 它是穆斯林征服拜占庭叙利亚的关键一战，为控制约旦河谷与巴勒斯坦打开通道。
entries.significanceEn: It was a key engagement in the conquest of Byzantine Syria and opened the Jordan Valley to the Muslim advance.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为635年1月（月精度），英文维基正文记为634年12月或635年1月，条目采用年精度并取635年，跨年可能已在此说明。中文维基百科尚无该条目。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records January 635 at month precision, while the English article dates the battle to December 634 or January 635; the entry keeps year precision and takes 635, with the possible previous year recorded here. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 隆新战役发生于1966年8月18日至21日，地点在南越福绥省隆新附近的橡胶园，是越南战争中的一场交战。交战一方为越共与北越军队，另一方为澳大利亚第一特遣部队。澳军在努伊达基地的炮兵支援下抵御优势兵力，最终守住阵地，战斗持续三日。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Long Tan took place from 18 to 21 August 1966 in a rubber plantation near Long Tan, Phuoc Tuy Province, South Vietnam, during the Vietnam War. It was fought between Viet Cong and North Vietnamese units and elements of the 1st Australian Task Force, who held their position with artillery support against a much larger force.
entries.significanceZh: 它使澳大利亚第一特遣部队守住了在福绥省的驻地，成为澳军参与越战的主要战斗之一。
entries.significanceEn: It allowed the 1st Australian Task Force to hold its base in Phuoc Tuy and became one of the best-known Australian actions of the war.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为1966年8月18日，英文维基正文记该战役为8月18日至21日，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 18 August 1966 and the English article dates the battle from 18 to 21 August; the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event; the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 克节朗战役（印度称南卡曲战役）是1962年中印边境战争的第一场战役。解放军以西藏军区前线指挥部为主，并投入陆军第11师部分分队；印度陆军第7步兵旅在此战中遭受毁灭性打击，失去作战能力，其旅长与四名营级主官被俘。解放军随即乘胜追击，占领藏南达旺地区。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Namka Chu, as India calls it, was the first battle of the 1962 Sino-Indian War. Chinese forces built around the Tibet Military District's front headquarters, with parts of the 11th Division, destroyed the Indian 7th Infantry Brigade, which lost its fighting capacity; its brigade commander and four battalion commanders were captured. Chinese forces then took Tawang.
entries.significanceZh: 此役摧毁印军第7步兵旅，为解放军随后占领达旺打开通路。
entries.significanceEn: The destruction of the Indian brigade opened the way for the Chinese advance on Tawang.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为1962年（年精度），与中文维基正文所述1962年一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科有该条目，英文维基百科尚无该条目，本条目主要据中文维基与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 1962 at year precision, matching the Chinese article, and the entry keeps year precision. A Chinese Wikipedia article exists while the English Wikipedia has no article for this event; the entry is written from the Chinese article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 诺提姆之战发生于公元前406年，是伯罗奔尼撒战争期间斯巴达在海上取得的一次胜利。雅典将领阿尔西比亚德斯此前将舰队交给舵手安条克指挥，安条克违令以诱敌小船挑动斯巴达舰队出战，结果被吕山德击败。此役导致阿尔西比亚德斯失势，也确立了吕山德在海上对抗雅典的声威。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Notium, also called the battle of Ephesus, was a Spartan naval victory in 406 BC during the Peloponnesian War. Alcibiades had left his helmsman Antiochus in command of the Athenian fleet blockading Ephesus; against orders Antiochus tried to lure the Spartans out with a decoy and was defeated by Lysander. The defeat ended Alcibiades' command.
entries.significanceZh: 此役使阿尔西比亚德斯失去指挥权，并确立了吕山德作为能击败雅典舰队的将领的声威。
entries.significanceEn: It ended Alcibiades' command and established Lysander as a commander able to beat the Athenians at sea.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为 ISO 天文纪年 −406，英文维基正文记该战役发生于公元前406年，与本条民用纪年写法 −406（即前406年）一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 is the ISO astronomical year -406 and the English article dates the battle to 406 BC, which this entry writes as -406 under the civil-year convention; year precision is kept. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.
